owner: REASONING COACH (Claude Desktop d82c3a44), policy only
consumer: AI HARNESS 8e75e3: the selector lives in CEE and writes TS predicates over the named signals below. PANEL renders. No second, UI-side guidance system (DL 5930647566).
contract: acceptance-cases.json is the behaviour contract. The harness imports it into its vitest suite and runs its real selector against it. check-policy.mjs only lints this file's shape.
principles: Coach the user's reasoning, not the graph. Every row leads with a decision question in the user's words; the model action comes second.
Trigger only on typed canonical state (the signals below). Never on text heuristics over chat, never on regex.
A signal that is pending or absent means SILENCE, never a fallback guess.
One intervention at a time. A decision point always outranks a method.
A pressed, dismissed or completed intervention returns only when its state_key changes, or the user asks for it.
Never diagnose the user. Describe the pattern, say why it matters, offer a test.
Never state a science number that is on the never_coach list. Never claim nothing would change the answer.

turn.request.meaning: Which request this reply answers: 'run_result' (two-request Run, request 1), 'narration' (request 2, body.chip.id starts 'agent-explain-run:'), 'turn' (any other Agent turn), 'method' (the user pressed a method chip or menu item).
turn.request.source: AI HARNESS two-request contract #85 5931099857 (R1, R3); chip id on the inbound body
turn.request.interim: Until it lands, treat every Agent turn as 'turn' and a press of any rc:* or agent-next-* chip as 'method'.

open.decision_point.meaning: True when the CHAT REPLY carries a pending decision or a specific next action the user must take first: an approval/amend card (including the M1 card itself until it is applied or dismissed), the Run offer, a readiness blocker with one action, B3 At least / At most in the chat, or a choose-one-of-three reading.
open.decision_point.source: TurnContext.open (F2 contract); interim = agent-v1-turn.ts offeredSpecific non-empty (lines 2358-2372 at cee_staging)
open.decision_point.never: Persistent result-panel controls never count: DGAI #2408's option-row 'N links not sized yet: [Accept starting strength] [Edit]' is always on screen while a link is unsized, so counting it would silence the M1 chat challenge on D1 for good. Both paths size the same link through the same authority; once either is applied the link is no longer S1.

run.kind.meaning: analysis_state.run_state.kind as served: complete_current | complete_stale | never_run | running | refused | blocked | unknown_degraded (CEE compose/analysis-state-v1.ts @1a896530; never 'none', SCIENCE/DSK 5937936336). RC rows test only complete_current / complete_stale.

run.leader_licensed.meaning: True only when the run licenses naming a leading option.
run.leader_licensed.source: interim analysis_state.leader_claim.permitted === true; target = the ONE leaderLicence read, compose/leader-licence.ts (AI HARNESS PR-L1)

run.withheld_reason.meaning: analysis_state.leader_claim.withheld_reason. Codes used here: no_option_meets_limit, every_option_likely_breaks_limit, options_do_not_separate. Any other code: no row keys on it.

run.decision_sensitivity.meaning: {status: measured | none_measurable | not_measured, most_sensitive?: {factor_id, label, range?: olumi_assumed | yours}}. Read from factor_evppi only.
run.decision_sensitivity.note: analysis_state.robustness.factors_that_flip_leader is NEVER emitted (analysis-state-v1.ts L-B). Do not key on it.

model.goal_label.meaning: The goal node's label, for copy fill only.

model.goal_horizon.meaning: When the goal must be met: {deadline: YYYY-MM-DD} or {months: n}. Absent = undated; never invent one.
model.goal_horizon.interim: Treat as absent: use the undated copy.

model.status_quo_option_id.meaning: The status-quo option id, or null.
model.status_quo_option_id.source: CEE agent-lane/structural-facts.ts statusQuoOptionId(nodes, edges); after the 0.69.0 pin, also schemas option_status

model.non_sq_option_ids.meaning: The user's own options: option node ids minus the status-quo option, minus any option whose option_participation state is excluded_* (today, e.g. excluded_olumi_proposed) or whose option_status is excluded_* once 0.69.0 is pinned.

model.option_labels.meaning: Option id -> label, for copy fill only.

model.same_lever.meaning: True when two options IN THE CURRENT COMPARISON (model.non_sq_option_ids) share > 60% of their intervention targets AND move every shared target the same way from the baseline (the status-quo option's value, else the factor's observed value, else 0): they differ only in amount (narrow framing, DSK-B-007).
model.same_lever.source: AI HARNESS assembles it (#2465 guidance-signals.ts): F1's detectSameLeverOptions(graph, 0.6) supplies the target overlap; the comparison set (non_sq) and the direction check are this contract's rule.
model.same_lever.never: Not for opposite allocations of one resource (D1: AI-reporting capacity 100% vs 0% is a real trade-off), and never counting an option left out of the comparison (D2's pilot, D3 s1's phased). F1's detectSameLeverOptions(graph, 0.6) alone over-fires: it was true on all 9 served cases (RC + AI HARNESS #2465, 1 Oct 16:2xZ).

model.goal_path_factor_ids.meaning: Factor node ids with a directed path to the goal.

model.goal_path_links.meaning: Links on any directed path from an option's intervention factor to the goal: [{link_id, from_label, to_label, link_sizing, option_ids}]. Each entry also carries goal_distance (fewest edges to the goal; used by the pick rule).
model.goal_path_links.owner: AI HARNESS computes; F1b owns linkSizing
model.goal_path_links.value_hash: computeResponseHash({strength, exists_probability, effect_direction}) of the stored edge (AI HARNESS #2465 guidance-signals.ts; RC tools/select_ref.py, 93/93 JS parity)

model.goal_path_factors.meaning: Factors on those paths: [{factor_id, label, value_authorship: yours | olumi_estimate | olumi_accepted | unknown}]. Each entry also carries goal_distance (fewest edges to the goal; used by the pick rule).
model.goal_path_factors.owner: AI HARNESS computes; F1 owns authorship
model.goal_path_factors.value_hash: computeResponseHash(observed_state {value, raw_value, unit, baseline, cap}) of the stored factor (AI HARNESS #2465 guidance-signals.ts; RC tools/select_ref.py, 93/93 JS parity)

model.placeholder_goal_links.meaning: Links nobody sized that sit on an option's path to the goal. While one exists that option's goal figures are withheld.
model.placeholder_goal_links.source: CEE agent-lane/goal-certainty.ts placeholderGoalPaths(graph, optionIds, identityEvaluations, scoredInterventions)

model.link_sizing.meaning: Per link: user | placeholder | olumi_accepted | olumi_estimate | unmarked.
model.link_sizing.source: CEE cee/magnitude/link-sizing.ts linkSizing(edge) (#2446, merged at cee_staging)

model.value_authorship.meaning: Per factor value: whose figure it is (yours, or Olumi's estimate, accepted or not).

since_run.goal_path_user_edits.meaning: User edits since the last Run (or since COACH_MY_EDITS last completed) on goal-path entities. Counted kinds: factor_value_edit, edge_strength_edit, link_effect_edit, option_intervention_edit, goal_target_edit, limit_edit, prior_range_edit, structural_add, structural_add_edge, structural_remove, structural_delete. Not counted: structural_rename, position or label-only edits.
since_run.goal_path_user_edits.source: inbound system_event kinds (CEE system-events/dispatch.ts) + run_delta.input_changes[] after a rerun; F2 since_run slice
since_run.goal_path_user_edits.status: pending:AI HARNESS since_run slice (F2-4); no typed edit-author field exists today
since_run.goal_path_user_edits.interim: Silent. Do not infer edits from the agent lane's '(Board edit' text prefix.

guidance.meaning: Per policy_id (and per item for RC-STRENGTHEN-ITEM): {status: offered | pressed | completed | dismissed, state_key_hash, turn_id}.
guidance.source: v5_conversation_turns.coaching_state (existing column, content-free envelope coaching-state-snapshot.ts); F2-3
guidance.interim: Without persisted guidance, offer at most once per turn and never the item pressed on the previous turn in the same session.

user.explicit_request.meaning: The user invoked this method by name (menu item, pill, or typed chip id). Bypasses cooldown; still records 'pressed'.

user.selected_option_id.meaning: The option the user picked on the RC-PREMORTEM choose_plan buttons (an explicit user choice only; never inferred from chat text or a leader that is not licensed). Null otherwise.
user.selected_option_id.source: the choose_plan button press (AI HARNESS carries it to the next method turn; = SCIENCE/DSK methodScienceContext user_selected_option_id, #2466)

selection.run_result_rule: Request 1 carries only the typed result and the 'Explain this result' chip (agent-explain-run:<run_key>). No coaching row is offered on request 1.
selection.explain_this_result: A continuation of the Run, not a coaching intervention. It never counts against the budget below.
selection.suppression: If open.decision_point is true, offer NO coaching row and no RC-COACH-EDITS pill. The decision comes first.

budget.slot_1: The single highest-priority eligible row among RC-WIDEN, RC-WHAT-CHANGES, RC-STRENGTHEN-ITEM, RC-PREMORTEM.
budget.slot_2: RC-COACH-EDITS, only when eligible. It is user-initiated, so it may sit beside slot 1.

tie_break: Same priority and the SAME item (e.g. RC-WHAT-CHANGES and RC-STRENGTHEN-ITEM both name factor X): offer RC-WHAT-CHANGES only. Reasoning framing wins over the model action.
Otherwise by row order: RC-WIDEN, RC-WHAT-CHANGES, RC-STRENGTHEN-ITEM, RC-PREMORTEM.
selection.method_turn_rule: On a 'method' turn, offer no other method. Offer only that method's own follow-up actions.
selection.cooldown_default: A row (or item) with guidance status pressed, dismissed or completed is not offered while its current state_key_hash equals the recorded one. user.explicit_request bypasses this.
selection.state_key_persistence: On disk (coaching_state, CEE #2459 agent_guidance envelope) an entry is {status, state_key_hash, turn_id}. state_key_hash = computeResponseHash(fields) (CEE utils/response-hash.ts; identical to #2459 stateKeyHash): sha256(JSON.stringify(canonical(fields))) first 12 hex, canonical = object keys sorted, ARRAY ORDER KEPT. Never persist raw values (coaching_state is content-free).
selection.cold_reload: Guidance must round-trip through coaching_state: a pressed or dismissed row stays hidden after a cold reload with an unchanged state_key (#2388 two-load lesson).
selection.cooldown_scope: Variant rows (RC-WIDEN): pick the first variant that holds, THEN apply cooldown to that pick; a row in cooldown does NOT fall through to its later variants (case A-WIDEN-SAME-KEY-HIDDEN: W1 dismissed, W2 also holds, RC-WIDEN stays hidden). Item rows (RC-STRENGTHEN-ITEM): cooldown is per item, so a cooled item falls through to the next candidate in pick order, and across variants (S1, then S2, S3L, S3V).
selection.state_key_rule: Each row's state_key.shape gives the exact fields. Build them with arrays in the stated order (ids sorted ascending; edits sorted by entity_id, then field) and OMIT any null or absent field (JS canonical keeps null, so a null would change the hash). The selector compares stateKeyHash(current fields) with the entry's state_key_hash. Verified: tools/select_ref.state_key_hash equals #2459 stateKeyHash on all 18 case entries + a non-ASCII control (RC, 1 Oct 14:3xZ).
selection.reference: tools/select_ref.py is the reference selector. build-cases.py refuses to write the cases if any case disagrees with it, or if any of its MUTANTS survives every case.
selection.entry_key: The policy id, or for a per-item row `RC-STRENGTHEN-ITEM:` + stateKeyHash({item_id}). Never the raw item id: node ids carry the user's words, and '->' in a link id fails the envelope KEY pattern /^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}$/, so a raw link key would be dropped on read and the item's cooldown lost after reload.

rows.name: Widen the options

variants.when: run.kind == complete_current AND run.withheld_reason in [no_option_meets_limit, every_option_likely_breaks_limit]

trigger_predicate.pick: The first variant that holds, in the order listed.

silent_when: open.decision_point
turn.request == run_result
guidance[RC-WIDEN] is pressed, dismissed or completed with an unchanged state_key
the only reason would be to reach a count; never add items for their own sake
rows.priority: per variant (W1, W2Z, W2 = P1; W3-W6 = P3; W7 = P5)

reasoning_question.W1: None of these looks likely to stay within your limit. Is there another way to get there?
reasoning_question.W2: Is it really just {option_label} or carry on as now? What other routes are there?
reasoning_question.W3: These options all pull the same lever. Is there a different way to reach the goal?
reasoning_question.W4: Would carrying on as now be a real option worth comparing against?
reasoning_question.W5: These options come out about the same. Is there a hybrid that takes the best of each?
reasoning_question.W6: What else could stop this working?
reasoning_question.W2Z: What could you actually do about {goal_label}? Name the routes you are weighing.

short_copy.W1: Every option looks likely to break your limit. Worth finding another route?
short_copy.W2: Only one real option on the table. Decisions go better with alternatives.
short_copy.W3: These options all work through the same lever. A different mechanism?
short_copy.W4: Comparing against 'carry on as now' shows what each change really adds.
short_copy.W5: The options come out close. A hybrid might beat both.
short_copy.W6: Only one risk is on the map. What else could go wrong?
short_copy.W7: Few drivers are mapped for {goal_label}. What else moves it?
short_copy.W2Z: No options on the table yet. What could you do?

why_now.W1: The analysis checked your limit and no option clears it.
why_now.W2: There is one option besides carrying on as now.
why_now.W3: Most of the options change the same factors.
why_now.W4: There is no 'carry on as now' option to compare with.
why_now.W5: The analysis could not separate the options.
why_now.W6: The model has at most one risk.
why_now.W7: Two or fewer factors lead to the goal.
why_now.W2Z: The model has a goal but no option besides carrying on as now.

primary_action.behaviour: Olumi proposes up to 3 materially distinct items, each grounded in the brief or the model, starting with any Olumi-proposed option already left out of the comparison. They are shown as decision-point buttons ('Add' per item, plus 'Something else'). Nothing is added until the user chooses.

rows.progressive_detail: Why: one line on the variant's why_now, with its source (Grammar §3 coaching pattern). Detail on click: the science basis in one sentence.

bias_cue.narrow_framing: These options all work through the same lever, which can hide better routes.
bias_cue.status_quo: Without a 'carry on as now' option it is hard to see what each change really adds.

state_key.note: W2-W4 and W7 keys exclude withheld_reason, so a new limit verdict alone does not bring the row back. Options added through this method change the key; the row returns only while a variant still holds.
state_key.shape: {variant_id, target, non_sq_option_ids (sorted)} + withheld_reason for W1/W5 + risk_ids (sorted) for target risks

rows.reentry_rule: Returns only when the option set (or risk set for W6) or withheld_reason changes AND a variant still holds.
rows.completion_rule: Completed when the user adds at least one proposed item, or chooses 'Something else' / says none apply.
rows.human_control_rule: Never adds an option, risk or factor without the user's choice. Each accepted item lands as ONE change card (before, after, Apply, Edit, Undo).

science_basis.summary: Decisions framed with a single alternative ('whether or not') fail more often than ones with real alternatives; generating options before evaluating is a core decision-quality step.
dsk: DSK-P-004 (opportunity cost prompting, elicit_options): frame|ideate only, never for go/no-go; badge only via MethodScienceContext (method_turns.shared.dsk_provenance)

rows.name: What would change the decision?
silent_when: open.decision_point
turn.request == run_result
run.decision_sensitivity.status in [none_measurable, not_measured]
run.kind != complete_current (stale, withheld or no run)
run.leader_licensed != true
guidance[RC-WHAT-CHANGES] pressed, dismissed or completed with an unchanged state_key

reasoning_question.range_olumi_assumed: Do you know {factor_label} more precisely? Within Olumi's assumed range it could change which option leads.
reasoning_question.range_yours_or_unknown: Would {leader_label} still be the best choice if {factor_label} turned out different?

rows.why_now: The analysis found that the answer is sensitive to {factor_label}.
rows.progressive_detail: Click reveals: which figure it is, whose figure it is (yours / Olumi's estimate), and one line on what the analysis varied. No numbers from never_coach.
rows.reentry_rule: Returns after a new Run whose most sensitive factor differs, or after that factor's value or authorship changed.
rows.completion_rule: Completed when the user gives an estimate for the factor, or the method turn answers (discussed).
rows.human_control_rule: Never changes the value. An estimate the user gives goes through the normal inline edit and is recorded as theirs.
never_say: a win probability or 'chance it wins'
EVPI, EVPPI, elasticity, sensitivity score, 'strongest driver'
'No single assumption measurably changes which option leads' or any claim that nothing would change the answer (factor_evppi is structurally flat in additive lever models, P3C A2)
'assumption' when only factor values were varied; say 'this figure'

science_basis.summary: Expected value of partial perfect information ranks which uncertain input could change the choice. Attention goes to the input that matters to the decision, not the one with the biggest structural weight.

rows.note: Expect this row to fire rarely today: factor_evppi is structurally flat in additive lever models (P3C A2), and every served run read on 1 Oct had EVPPI empty or below resolution and every flip_thresholds row no_flip_in_range. Silence is the correct output there. It fires once identity kinds (product, stock-flow) make a factor interact with a lever.

rows.name: Strengthen this assumption or link

variants.when: a link L in model.placeholder_goal_links AND no open decision point is about L
a link in model.goal_path_links with link_sizing in [placeholder, olumi_estimate]
a factor in model.goal_path_factors whose value_authorship is olumi_estimate

trigger_predicate.pick: The first variant that holds. Within a variant: smallest goal_distance (fewest edges from the link's target node, or from the factor, to the goal), then lexicographic id. `item_one_of` in a case lists every candidate in this order; `item` is the pick.

forbidden_without: a named item (link or factor id)
silent_when: open.decision_point (the F1b B2 [Accept starting strength][Edit] IS this action for a placeholder link)
turn.request == run_result
no item qualifies: never offer a generic 'Strengthen the model'
the item is user-sized (link_sizing == user) or the value is yours
guidance[RC-STRENGTHEN-ITEM, item] pressed, dismissed or completed with an unchanged state_key
rows.priority: per variant (S1 = P1, S2 = P2, S3L/S3V = P5; S3L before S3V)

reasoning_question.S1: How much does {from_label} really change {to_label}? The comparison turns on it.
reasoning_question.S2: Do you know {factor_label} more precisely? It's Olumi's estimate and the comparison is sensitive to it.
reasoning_question.S3L: Does {from_label} really move {to_label} as much as Olumi assumed?
reasoning_question.S3V: What figure would you use for {factor_label}?

short_copy.S1: The comparison rests on a link nobody has sized yet.
short_copy.S2: The answer is sensitive to {factor_label}, Olumi's estimate.
short_copy.S3L: The effect of {from_label} is Olumi's guess.

why_now.S1: Until it is sized, Olumi can't compare the options on your goal.
why_now.S2: The analysis found this figure matters to the choice.
why_now.S3L: It sits on the path to your goal.

secondary_actions.label: Use Olumi's estimate
secondary_actions.note: For a link this is F1b's accept path (link becomes olumi_accepted). Still Olumi's figure; earns no authorship credit.

rows.progressive_detail: Click reveals: whose figure it is, which option or conclusion depends on it, and what the user's own number would change. One level of disclosure.

state_key.shape: {item_id, link_sizing, value_hash} for a link; {item_id, value_authorship, value_hash} for a factor (exact JSON, as acceptance-cases records it)
state_key.scope: per item: dismissing X does not block Y
state_key.note: Content-free: value_hash is computeResponseHash of the STORED value (link {strength, exists_probability, effect_direction}; factor observed_state {value, raw_value, unit, baseline, cap}), never the value itself. A user edit makes the item yours, which ends its eligibility; a changed Olumi estimate brings a dismissed item back (RC ruling for AI HARNESS 5936122586).

rows.cooldown_rule: Default cooldown, per item. At most one RC-STRENGTHEN-ITEM offer per turn.
rows.reentry_rule: Item X returns only if its sizing, authorship or stored value (value_hash) changes, or it becomes S1/S2 after a new Run.
rows.completion_rule: Completed when X's authorship changes (user or olumi_accepted) or the method turn answers.
rows.human_control_rule: Never sizes or changes a link or value itself. Every change goes through an inline edit or a change card the user applies.
never_say: 'Strengthen the model' with no named item
a percentage chance attached to the link

science_basis.summary: Assumption-based planning: name the load-bearing assumption, test it, and replace a guessed number with the decision-maker's own judgement where the choice depends on it.
refs: Spetzler & Staël von Holstein (1975) probability encoding

rows.name: Pre-mortem

trigger_predicate.explicit_request: On user.explicit_request with a goal and at least one option, run it at any stage. The plan is the licensed leader, else the single user option; with no licensed leader and 2+ user options the method first asks which option to stress-test (mode choose_plan: one button per user option + 'Talk it through'; the pick is user-selected, PTL 5933036532 #5), then runs on it. With no current Run, use the qualitative protocol: no invented winner, probability or figure (SCI-09).

forbidden_without: a plan to stress: a licensed leader, or a single option with a risk on the map, or an explicit request
silent_when: open.decision_point
turn.request == run_result
guidance[RC-PREMORTEM] completed with an unchanged state_key (never rerun without new cause, SCI-08)

run.withheld_reason in [no_option_meets_limit, every_option_likely_breaks_limit]: the analysis already shows every option likely misses a limit, so there is no plan to stress (DSK-P-001 needs an identified winning option); RC-WIDEN W1 is the move
pre-structure: no goal or no option

reasoning_question.dated: Imagine it's {horizon} and {plan_label} has gone badly. What most likely went wrong?
reasoning_question.undated: Imagine {plan_label} has gone badly. What most likely went wrong?

rows.short_copy: Imagine {plan_label} has failed. What went wrong?
rows.why_now: There is a plan to stress-test now: {plan_label}.

primary_action.label: Run a pre-mortem
primary_action.behaviour: Olumi writes 2-3 plausible failure stories. Each one must name at least one model item: a risk node, an Olumi-estimated link on the plan's path, or a limit at risk. For each: one warning sign to watch and one mitigation. Presented as stories, never as predictions.

secondary_actions.label: Add this as a risk
secondary_actions.note: A change card; nothing is added without Apply.

rows.progressive_detail: Stories first; warning signs and mitigations behind 'Show more'.

fields: leader option id if licensed else the single option id
state_key.note: Deliberately excludes the risk set. Risks added by the pre-mortem itself must not make it come back (SCI-08).

rows.reentry_rule: Returns only when the plan under test (the leader) or the option set changes.
rows.completion_rule: Completed once the stories are shown (the method turn answered).
truth_dependencies: linkSizing for the Olumi-estimated links it may cite (F1b)
rows.human_control_rule: Stories are prompts for the user's judgement. Any risk or mitigation enters the model only through a change card the user applies.
never_say: a winner when no leader is licensed
rows.horizon_rule: Use model.goal_horizon: {months: n} -> '{n} months from now' ('a month from now' for 1); {deadline} -> the date as '2 November'. Absent or pending -> the undated question. Never default to a year.

science_basis.summary: Prospective hindsight (imagining the failure has already happened) surfaces more and more specific reasons for failure than asking what might go wrong.
refs: Klein (2007) Performing a project premortem, HBR
dsk: DSK-P-001 (Pre-mortem exercise): evaluate|decide, not with one option and no meaningful alternatives; badge only via MethodScienceContext

rows.name: Coach my edits
silent_when: open.decision_point
turn.request == run_result
only rename, position or label edits
the same edit set was already coached
since_run.goal_path_user_edits is pending (today): silent, never inferred from chat text
rows.reasoning_question: You changed {edit_summary}. What does that do to the choice?
rows.why_now: You changed {edit_count} thing(s) that feed the goal since the last run.

primary_action.label: Coach my edits
primary_action.behaviour: One-line insight, then at most 3 bullets: (1) what changed, before and after; (2) which assumption or trade-off that touches; (3) which conclusion may now change. Last line: if run.kind == complete_stale, 'The analysis is out of date' (F1/F1b own that fact) and offer a rerun only if the model may run.

rows.progressive_detail: Each bullet expands to the specific item (O1 / F2 numbering) on click.

fields: edits: the uncoached goal-path edits, each {kind, entity_id, field, after_hash}

rows.cooldown_rule: Default cooldown; a new edit makes a new key.
rows.reentry_rule: Returns when there is at least one goal-path edit not in the last coached set.
rows.completion_rule: Completed when the method turn answers.
rows.human_control_rule: Never auto-runs, never auto-approves, never changes the graph.

science_basis.summary: Prompt reflection on the consequences of one's own change gives the timely feedback that judgement needs; considering what the change implies counters taking it at face value.
refs: Kahneman & Klein (2009) conditions for intuitive expertise
Lord, Lepper & Preston (1984) consider the opposite

agent-next-pre-mortem.verdict: RETIRE the static chip; the row replaces it

agent-next-what-would-change.verdict: RETIRE the static chip; offered only with a licensed leader and measured sensitivity

agent-next-strengthen.verdict: RETIRE the generic label; the row always names the item

METHOD_CATALOGUE.reframe_problem.reason: No typed trigger for a mis-framed question today. Stays a menu method; not proactively offered.

METHOD_CATALOGUE.different_option.reason: Same move (elicit_options). Menu press = user.explicit_request for RC-WIDEN target options. DSK-P-004 provenance only via MethodScienceContext (frame|ideate, not go/no-go).

METHOD_CATALOGUE.consider_opposite.reason: Challenge-the-leader is deferred past the five (brief §8). Menu only.

METHOD_CATALOGUE.outside_view.reason: Base-rate method deferred (brief §8): no typed reference-class data to ground it.

METHOD_CATALOGUE.pre_mortem.reason: Same move. Menu press = user.explicit_request. DSK-P-001 provenance only via MethodScienceContext (evaluate|decide, 2+ options).

METHOD_CATALOGUE.explore_tradeoffs.reason: Generic pros/cons deferred (brief §8). No intent, plain chat.

METHOD_CATALOGUE.review_bias.reason: The one-line bias element (Grammar §3) comes from RC-WIDEN's typed bias_cue (narrow_framing, status_quo). The menu item shows the current cue if there is one; with none it says no pattern was found, never a generic bias lecture.

waiting_library.rule: Deterministic, no LLM call, no added latency. Rotate within the current phase only. Never claim progress that has not happened. Result-first always wins: drop the line the moment the result is ready. Each line is 90 characters or fewer.

phase_of.reading_brief: the brief has been sent and drafting has not produced structure yet

reading_brief: Good decisions start with the real question, not the first one that comes to mind.
Decisions with real alternatives tend to go better than 'whether or not' choices.
A goal written as a number makes it easier to tell which option gets there.
structuring: Separating what you control from what you can't makes trade-offs easier to see.
A cause-and-effect map shows which assumptions your choice actually rests on.
Each figure is marked as yours or Olumi's estimate, so you can see what to check.
running_analysis: The analysis tries many combinations of the uncertain values in your model.
Results show what follows from the model's assumptions, not a forecast.
Often one or two figures decide the choice. Those are the ones worth checking.
preparing_explanation: Olumi only puts an option forward when the analysis supports it.
A result is only as strong as the figures behind it. Look for which are yours.
Where a figure is Olumi's estimate, your own number can sharpen the answer.

structuring: Howard (1988) decision analysis: decisions vs uncertainties
running_analysis: SCI-04: simulation frequency is not real-world probability

user_language.risk: Something that might happen and would hurt the goal (an event or exposure). Example: 'a key engineer leaves'.
user_language.negative_factor: A quantity where more of it hurts the goal. Example: 'monthly cloud spend'.
user_language.adverse_outcome: The bad result itself. Example: 'missing the funding target'.
user_language.constraint: A limit you will not cross. Example: 'churn must stay under 3%'.
user_language.uncertainty: How sure we are about a figure or a link.
user_language.status: Draft user-language mapping for display and coaching only. No node-type or schema change. MG (F1) to confirm the model semantics.

method_turns.purpose: What a method must produce when pressed. Every post_check is a DETERMINISTIC text rule with an id (Ticket 1 implements all of them in checkMethodTurn). Rules that need structured output are listed under structured_checks; they are AI HARNESS's (method-turn output format) and are NOT part of the text checker. The runtime checks the draft BEFORE it is sent (shared.runtime); if any check fails, it sends the deterministic fallback instead.

shared.shape: One-line insight, then the method's body, then ONE action (Grammar §3). Details collapsed.
shared.grounding: Only the typed inputs listed per method plus the user's own words. Every specific claim names a supplied item by its label or ref (O1, F2, R1).
never: a probability, percentage or win share unless the user stated it
a leading option when run.leader_licensed is false
'the model was saved', implementation detail, internal ids
EVPI, elasticity, sensitivity score, placeholder, edge, node

parsing.numbered_items: items start on a new line with /^\s*[1-9]\.\s/ ; an item runs until the next numbered line, an 'Outside the model:' line, or the end
parsing.bullet_items: items start on a new line with /^\s*-\s/ ; the item NAME is the text before the first ':' on that line
parsing.normalise: lower-case, curly quotes to straight, strip punctuation and collapse whitespace
parsing.label_match: case-insensitive substring match of a supplied label after normalise, or a supplied ref (O1, F2, R1) as a whole word
parsing.number_tokens: /(?<![A-Za-z])[£$€]?\d[\d,]*(\.\d+)?\s*(%|k|m|bn)?/i, ignoring list markers at the start of a line; a token is 'supplied' if its digits appear in the inputs, the brief or the user's messages
parsing.blindspot_line: a line matching /^\s*Outside the model:\s/ ; it is never part of a numbered item
parsing.item_match: a supplied item {id, labels[], ref?} matches a text when its ref appears as a whole word, or when EVERY one of its labels label_matches (a link carries its two end labels, so the text must name both ends)
parsing.target: per numbered item: the id of the FIRST supplied item, in supplied order, that matches it; null when none does

runtime.rule: The runtime calls checkMethodTurn on the draft reply BEFORE sending it. Any failed id: send the row's deterministic fallback instead. Never repair and resend, never a second LLM call, never a post-hoc score in place of the check.
never: a method turn on request 1 of the two-request Run
an extra LLM call inside a Run

action_target.rule: Every grounded failure story (RC-PREMORTEM) or option gap (RC-WIDEN) carries the id of the node, link or option it rests on. The turn ends in ONE existing typed change card on one of those ids: confirm, the Run goes stale, rerun, then the Changes delta (RERUN-EXPLANATION states a cause only for C1_attributable). With no target the turn is discussion only, and it does not count as the investor moment.
action_target.cards: The agent lane's propose_* card tools (src/orchestrator-v5/agent-lane/runtime/agent-tools.ts @ e3fb5090): propose_link_strengths (Olumi's band for the user to accept or edit; NEVER the singular propose_link_strength at :366, which is user-authored and refuses a band the user did not state, PTL 5933901307), propose_assumptions (:231, sets a factor to a stated assumption), propose_new_risk (:450), propose_new_option (:278; with a stored Olumi option's exact label it offers adoption, i.e. adopt_olumi_option), propose_new_factor (:484), propose_limit_change (:506). RC names the card; AI HARNESS composes it through the existing door. Nothing changes without Apply. Changing a limit to fit the plan is never a coaching action.
action_target.pass_condition: Investor moment (DL 5933063973 addition 2): the user acted on the challenge and saw the consequence, in R3's same F5 capture (D2, D3). The PM-*/WD-* pass rate is secondary.
action_target.grounded_inputs_shape: supplied_items = SCIENCE/DSK MethodScienceContext.grounded_inputs, passed unchanged: {id, kind: link|factor|risk|limit, labels[] (a link carries its two end labels), ref?, card} in ACTION-PRIORITY order. Labels and classes only, never a value. The reply names items by label; the checker returns the ids; an id never appears in the text.

A method turn shows DSK provenance only when SCIENCE/DSK's MethodScienceContext returns an applicable protocol id (one canonical lifecycle stage + every contraindication). No canonical stage, no citation. run.kind is currentness, never a stage. Without a badge the method still runs as product coaching.

label_masking.rule: Every text BAN (a pattern a reply must NOT contain) runs on the reply with the user's own labels blanked, PER BAN: a ban blanks only the labels in which that same ban matches (they are the user's words: 'Enterprise prospect signing likelihood' for PM-NO-PROB, 'Qualified leads per month' for RX-NO-LEADER-UNLICENSED), never a label it does not match (an unrelated label 'Will' must not hide 'This plan will fail'), and never a label that is nothing but banned words ('Odds', 'Leads': the check fails closed). Blanking is case-insensitive, curly quotes folded, longest label first, WHOLE TOKENS ONLY (a label is blanked only where no letter, digit or '_' touches either end; label matching is whole-token too). The candidate labels are model_labels (EVERY node label in the current model: goal, options, factors, risks, outcomes) plus the method's own labels: RC-PREMORTEM supplied_items + plan_label + current_option_labels; RERUN-EXPLANATION change_labels + current_option_labels; RC-WHAT-CHANGES factor_label; RC-STRENGTHEN-ITEM item_labels; RC-COACH-EDITS edited_labels.
label_masking.why: A label the user wrote is grounding, not a claim. Served D1 (the investor decision) has the factor 'Enterprise prospect signing likelihood': without masking every grounded pre-mortem failed PM-NO-PROB and fell back (SCIENCE/DSK 5938372911). RC served-label scan (CEE staging fixtures, 1,440 labels / 305 graphs): goal labels with '%' ('Cut Burn Rate by 30%'), factor labels with 'leads' ('Qualified leads per month'), risk labels with '%' ('Churn above 4%'): none of them supplied items, so the mask set is every model label. PER BAN (CODEX_CLI_OVERFLOW on CEE #2480 P1 #4): blanking every label let a common-word label ('Will') erase Olumi's own 'will fail'. Re-scan at per-ban (1,074 labels / 359 CEE fixture graphs): 17 labels carry a ban hit (11 '%'/probability words, 5 'leads', 1 'significant'), all multi-word and still blanked; 0 are wholly a ban token, so failing closed costs no served label.
label_masking.never: Mask Olumi's own words: only labels the inputs supply, only for a ban the label itself trips, only as whole tokens (option 'A' must never blank the 'a' in 'probability', HARNESS #2478 P1; label 'Will' must never blank 'will fail', #2480 P1 #4).
label_masking.reference: tools/check_method_turn.py banned() + masked(); fixtures MT-PREMORTEM-D1-OWN-LABEL-GOOD / -BAD-CLAIM, MT-RERUN-MODEL-LABEL-GOOD / -BAD-LEADER, MT-PREMORTEM-SHORT-LABEL-GOOD / -BAD, MT-PREMORTEM-COMMON-WORD-LABEL-BAD, MT-RERUN-BARE-BAN-LABEL-BAD
label_masking.input: model_labels: string[] = every node label of the current model (the caller has the graph).

inputs: plan: option label (leader if licensed, else the single user option); NOT a supplied item, so naming it alone is not grounding
goal label, target and horizon if set

supplied_items (shared.action_target.grounded_inputs_shape) in ACTION-PRIORITY order: (1) links on the plan's path with link_sizing placeholder or olumi_estimate, nearest the goal first (card propose_link_strengths); (2) goal-path factors whose value authorship is olumi_estimate, label + class only (card propose_assumptions); (3) risks on the plan's path (card propose_new_risk); (4) limits: label + verdict class (card propose_new_risk, a new risk into the limit)
RC-PREMORTEM.body: 2 failure stories (at most 3) told in the past tense ('It is a year later and ‘Switch to GCP’ went badly because…'). Each story: one or two sentences, rests on at least one supplied item, then 'Watch for:' one early warning sign and 'Mitigate:' one action. Then ONE line 'Outside the model: …?': a blind spot the model does not capture (DSK-P-001 step 2), asked as a question, never asserted, never numbered.
RC-PREMORTEM.action: ONE change card on action_target, the story target with the lowest supplied index, using that item's card: propose_link_strengths (Olumi's current band to accept or edit, the same door as M1's S1 card) for a link, propose_assumptions (the S3V card) for a factor, propose_new_risk ('Add this as a risk': a new risk linked into the target, label proposed from the story and editable on the card) for a risk or limit. Secondary: 'Talk it through'. Nothing is added without Apply.

post_checks.rule: 2 <= numbered_items <= 3
every numbered item has a target (matches >= 1 supplied item); the plan label alone does not count
every numbered item contains 'Watch for:' and 'Mitigate:'
no '%' and no /\b(likely|likelihood|chance|probability|probable|odds)\b/i anywhere (on the label-masked reply, shared.label_masking)
no /\b(will|is going to|are going to) fail\b/i (on the label-masked reply, shared.label_masking)
no current option label other than the plan's label_matches
exactly one blindspot_line; it ends with '?'; every numbered line comes before it

RC-PREMORTEM.fallback: Deterministic, no LLM: 'Imagine ‘{plan}’ has gone badly. Start with {first supplied item}: how would you notice it early, and what would you do?' with that item's card, plus 'Talk it through'.
RC-PREMORTEM.science: Prospective hindsight (Mitchell, Russo & Pennington 1989; Klein 2007). DSK-P-001 provenance only through MethodScienceContext (shared.dsk_provenance).
RC-PREMORTEM.format: Insight line, then 2-3 stories as a numbered list (each contains 'Watch for:' and 'Mitigate:'), then one 'Outside the model: …?' line.
RC-PREMORTEM.targets: checkMethodTurn returns targets[]: one per numbered item (parsing.target). The harness picks action_target from them.
RC-PREMORTEM.wording_owner: REASONING COACH owns the 'Outside the model: …?' wording and PM-BLINDSPOT (PTL 5933600218); PTL/DL may challenge.

choose_plan.when: user.explicit_request == RC-PREMORTEM AND the METHOD plan is unknown (no licensed leader, no user.selected_option_id) AND len(model.non_sq_option_ids) >= 1
choose_plan.copy: Which option do you want to stress-test?
choose_plan.choices: one button per model.non_sq_option_ids label (curly quotes, case kept), then 'Talk it through'
choose_plan.never: pick a plan for the user, or name a leader the Run did not license
choose_plan.why: D1 (the investor decision) has 2 options and a withheld leader; without this step the pre-mortem has no plan (RC reference selector, 1 Oct 14:5xZ).
choose_plan.then: The press sets user.selected_option_id; the next method turn runs on that option (no second ask). METHOD plan = licensed leader > user.selected_option_id (still in non_sq). It is never auto-named (PTL 5933036532 #5, merged in SCIENCE/DSK #2466; SCIENCE/DSK 5937084931).
choose_plan.row_press_is_a_pick: Pressing the RC-PREMORTEM ROW whose copy names the user's single option ('Imagine ‘Switch to GCP’ has failed…') IS the explicit pick: HARNESS sets user.selected_option_id to that option, so there is no one-button question. Only a GENERIC press (the static chip or the menu, which names no option) gets the choose_plan buttons, even for one option.
choose_plan.row_subject: The ROW's subject (copy + cooldown key) may name the single user option: that is not a leader claim. The METHOD plan sent to SCIENCE/DSK follows the precedence above.

inputs: current user options: label + ref + the factors each one changes
Olumi-proposed options left out of the comparison: label + ref
RC-WIDEN.body: Up to 3 items that work through a materially DIFFERENT mechanism from the current ones (options), or name a different way the plan could fail (risks), or a different driver of the goal (factors). Each item: a name of 6 words or fewer, then one line saying what it changes and why it might do better. Start with any Olumi-proposed option already left out of the comparison.
RC-WIDEN.action: Decision-point buttons: 'Add' per item, then 'Something else' (choose_1_of_3). Each Add lands as ONE change card on the item's refs: propose_new_option (a left-out Olumi option by its exact label = adoption; a new lever via its new_factors) for target options; propose_new_risk for risks; propose_new_factor for factors.

post_checks.rule: 1 <= bullet_items <= 3
no bullet NAME equals (after normalise) a CURRENT user option, risk or factor label; supplied left-out Olumi option labels are exempt
every number_token in the reply is supplied
variant W1 only: no bullet matches /\b(meets?|clears?|stays? (within|under)|within)\b[^.]{0,40}\blimit\b/i

RC-WIDEN.fallback: Deterministic: list the Olumi-proposed options left out (if any) as Add buttons; else 'What other way could you reach {goal}? For example, a different lever, a smaller first step, or a mix of these options.' with 'Talk it through'.
RC-WIDEN.science: Generating alternatives before evaluating; 'whether or not' framing fails more often (Nutt 1999; Keeney 1992; DSK-B-007). DSK-P-004 provenance only through MethodScienceContext (shared.dsk_provenance): never after a Run, never for go/no-go.
RC-WIDEN.format: Insight line, then 1-3 items as bullets '- {name}: {one line on what it changes}'.

structured_checks.owner: AI HARNESS (method-turn output format); NOT in Ticket 1's text checker
structured_checks.why: A materially different option usually works through a lever that is not in the model yet, so free text cannot be checked against model factors.
structured_checks.requires: the method turn returns items as {name, mechanism_kind: new_lever | hybrid | left_out_option | existing_factor, refs[]}; refs are supplied ids (option, limit, shared-lever factor, risk or goal) that the gap rests on

checks.rule: mechanism_kind hybrid: refs include >= 2 current option refs
mechanism_kind existing_factor: the factor ref is not in the current options' shared lever set
mechanism_kind left_out_option: name equals a supplied left-out option label
mechanism_kind new_lever: name and lever do not normalise-equal any shared-lever factor label
every item has >= 1 ref and every ref is a supplied id (the gap it rests on; DL 5933063973 addition 1)

inputs: decision_sensitivity.most_sensitive: factor label + ref, current value + unit, whose figure (yours | Olumi's estimate), range source
RC-WHAT-CHANGES.body: One line on what the analysis varied ('Olumi varied {factor} within the range it assumed'). Then up to 3 bullets on what would have to be true about {factor} for a different option to come out ahead, said qualitatively. Then the question asking for the user's estimate.
RC-WHAT-CHANGES.action: 'Give your estimate' (edit_inline on the factor) when the range is Olumi's; else 'Talk it through'.

post_checks.rule: label_matches the supplied factor label
every number_token is the factor's current value or a user figure
no /nothing would change|no single (assumption|factor)/i (on the label-masked reply, shared.label_masking)
no /\b(EVPI|EVPPI|sensitivity score|elasticity)\b/i and no '%' (on the label-masked reply, shared.label_masking)

RC-WHAT-CHANGES.fallback: Deterministic: the row's reasoning_question with the 'Give your estimate' action.
RC-WHAT-CHANGES.science: Value of information: attention goes to the input that can change the choice (Howard 1966).
RC-WHAT-CHANGES.format: Insight line naming what was varied, up to 3 bullets on what would have to be true, then the question.

honest_limit.when: The user explicitly asks (menu, chip or user.explicit_request) AND run.decision_sensitivity.status in [none_measurable, not_measured]. The row is never OFFERED in this state; this is how the method answers when asked.
honest_limit.text: Olumi can't yet measure what would change this choice in this model. The most useful thing to check meanwhile is {item_label}: it is Olumi's estimate and it sits on the path to your goal.
honest_limit.item: The RC-STRENGTHEN-ITEM pick (S1, then S3L, then S3V). With no Olumi estimate on a goal path, drop the second sentence.
honest_limit.deterministic: Fixed text: no LLM call. This is DL moment (b) 'or an honest limit', handing over to moment (a).
never: 'No single assumption measurably changes which option leads' or any rewording of it (AIQ P3C A2)
any claim that the choice is robust, safe or settled
honest_limit.wording_owner: REASONING COACH owns this copy (PTL 5933600218: AIQ is not a live lane); PTL/DL may challenge.
honest_limit.item_label: link → 'how much {from} affects {to}'; factor → 'the figure for {label}' (label case rule applies)

inputs: the item: link (from/to labels) or factor (label, current value + unit)
options whose goal figures depend on it
RC-STRENGTHEN-ITEM.body: Up to 3 bullets: what the figure means in plain words; one cheap way to pin it down (a number the user may already have, a quick test, someone to ask); what the user's own estimate would change for the comparison.
RC-STRENGTHEN-ITEM.action: ONE card per card_first (opens with the reply, no LLM): 'Give your estimate' (edit) with 'Use Olumi's estimate' (accept) as the secondary.

post_checks.rule: label_matches the item's label (both labels for a link)
no /\b(placeholder|edge|node|default strength)\b/i (on the label-masked reply, shared.label_masking)
every number_token is the item's current value or a user figure

RC-STRENGTHEN-ITEM.fallback: Deterministic: the row's reasoning_question with the inline edit.
RC-STRENGTHEN-ITEM.format: Up to 3 bullets: what the figure means, one cheap way to pin it down, what the user's estimate would change.

inputs: uncoached goal-path edits: label, field, before, after
options whose path the edited item sits on
RC-COACH-EDITS.body: One-line insight. Then at most 3 bullets: (1) what changed, before and after; (2) the assumption or trade-off it touches; (3) which conclusion may now change. Last line, only if run.kind is complete_stale: 'The analysis is out of date.' and offer a rerun.
RC-COACH-EDITS.action: 'Rerun' only when stale and the model may run; else none (coaching only).

post_checks.rule: label_matches every edited item's label (up to 3)
/out of date/i present if and only if run.kind == complete_stale
no /\b(the result (has )?changed|now leads|is now ahead|the answer is now)\b/i (on the label-masked reply, shared.label_masking)

RC-COACH-EDITS.fallback: Deterministic: 'You changed {edit list}. That changes {assumption}. ' + the stale line when stale.
RC-COACH-EDITS.science: Timely feedback on one's own change (Kahneman & Klein 2009); consider the implications (DSK-P-003).
RC-COACH-EDITS.format: Insight line, then up to 3 bullets (what changed, the assumption it touches, what may change), then the stale line only if stale.

RERUN-EXPLANATION.purpose: DL moment (c): revise → rerun → explain the difference. The narration of a RERUN (request 2) follows this; owner AI HARNESS (narration), signals from run_delta (CEE, strict schema).
inputs: no_matched_figures: run_delta.win_probabilities is empty (AVAILABLE today: 'no comparable pair', any cause)

body.C0_identical: Same inputs as the last run; say the result is unchanged, nothing more.
body.C1_attributable: Name each change (up to 3, before → after). Say what moved in the comparison. A cause may be stated, because the pair isolates the edit.
body.C2_unpaired: Name each change. Say the two runs differ in more than your edit (a new draw), so Olumi can't attribute the difference to the edit alone. State no cause.
body.UNWITHHELD: Only when prior_withheld is TRUE (typed; never inferred from an empty array): name each change and say that Olumi can now compare the options. Say the change is what held the comparison back ONLY when attribution_case is C1_attributable; otherwise give the case line instead (C2 / C3–C5) and never credit the edit (an engine-drift pair can un-withhold beside an unrelated edit; 52f8cd + Codex on CEE 864e915c). Never describe a movement: the earlier run held its comparison figures back. Name a leader only if run.leader_licensed (with its caveat).
body.NO_MATCHED_FIGURES: When no_matched_figures and prior_withheld is not true: name each change and describe no movement; say only what the run now shows (CANVAS's interim pill: 'This pair has no matched figures to compare.').

RERUN-EXPLANATION.format: One-line insight, then up to 3 bullets (one per change), then one line on what moved.

post_checks.rule: label_matches every input_changes label (up to 3)

if attribution_case != C1_attributable: no /\b(because (you|of your)|caused|due to your|as a result of your|led to|held (the|its) comparison back)\b/i (on the label-masked reply, shared.label_masking)
post_checks.source: ; + 'held the comparison back' (the contract's own UNWITHHELD template; 52f8cd 2 Oct)

post_checks.rule: if run.leader_licensed is false: no current option label appears together with /\b(leads|ahead|best|wins|now first)\b/i in the same sentence (on the label-masked reply, shared.label_masking)
if leader.noise_verdict is not_noise_qualified: no /\b(significant|meaningful(ly)? (better|worse)|clearly (better|worse))\b/i (on the label-masked reply, shared.label_masking)
if prior_withheld OR no_matched_figures: no /\b(rose|fell|moved|increased|decreased|went (up|down)|up from|down from|jumped|dropped|climbed)\b/i (on the label-masked reply, shared.label_masking)

if change_labels is non-empty (changes are recorded): no claim that nothing or no input changed, the WHOLE class: /\b(nothing('s| has| had)? changed|nothing (was|has been|had been) changed|nothing in (your|the) model('s| has| had)? changed|same inputs?|inputs?( values)? (were|was|are|is|stayed|remained|have stayed|have remained) (unchanged|the same)|unchanged inputs?|(no|none of the) inputs? (were |was |have been |has been )?changed|no changes? (were|was|have been|has been) made|(didn'?t|did not|haven't|have not|hasn't|has not) changed? anything)\b/i (on the label-masked reply, shared.label_masking). 'Nothing else changed.' is the honest control and passes.
post_checks.source: MG 5939414835; class widened per CODEX CEE BUDDY 5940259670 (seven forms passed the two-phrase ban); MG 5940298428 ('No changes were made.')

post_checks.rule: if prior_withheld: the reply carries 'can now compare the options' (whole-token label_matches), the UNWITHHELD line

RERUN-EXPLANATION.fallback: Deterministic: 'You changed {changes}. ' + (UNWITHHELD + C1: 'That was what held the comparison back, so Olumi can now compare the options.' | UNWITHHELD otherwise: 'Olumi can now compare the options.' + the case line | C2: 'Olumi can’t confirm both runs used the same draw, so the difference can’t be put down to your edit alone.' | C3/C4 (recorded difference): 'Other things also differed between these two runs, so the difference can't be put down to your edit alone.' | partial coverage or C5_unattributed: 'Olumi can’t confirm nothing else differed between these two runs, so the difference can’t be put down to your edit alone.' | C1: 'The comparison was rerun on the same draw.' | C0: 'Nothing else changed.')

accept_olumi_estimate.when: run_delta.input_changes[] row with field 'sizing', before 'placeholder', after 'olumi_accepted'
accept_olumi_estimate.label: You accepted Olumi's estimate for how much {from} changes {to}.

user_estimate.when: run_delta.input_changes[] row with field 'sizing', after 'user' (linkSizing literal, CEE src/cee/magnitude/link-sizing.ts:30 @8ee43f7a; the 'Edit the strength' path)
user_estimate.label: You gave your own estimate for how much {from} changes {to}.

change_label_templates.source: @talchain/schemas 0.70.0 (additive; 52f8cd 5937207590 + 5937225976): snapshot links[].sizing + links[].band, RunInputField 'sizing' (raw linkSizing classes) and 'strength' (raw band words); a mean move inside one band and one sizing stays partial with no row. CEE emits only once the UI vendors 0.70.
change_label_templates.why: A provenance-only Accept or edit must still be named as a change (R3 5936613334; DL 5936679883 owner chain: 52f8cd producer, CANVAS words).

strength.when: run_delta.input_changes[] row with field 'strength' (band word before → after; 52f8cd addendum 5937225976)
strength.label: You changed how much {from} changes {to}: {before} → {after}.

one_sentence_per_link.rule: A 'sizing' row and a 'strength' row for the SAME link (same label) are ONE change: one sentence, one bullet, and one entry in the up-to-3 count.
one_sentence_per_link.label: You gave your own estimate for how much {from} changes {to}: {before} → {after}.
one_sentence_per_link.why: 'Edit the strength' writes both rows (sizing placeholder → user, band moved); two bullets for one edit reads as two edits.

RERUN-EXPLANATION.investor_moment: M2 on the ruled seed (eeeff8b4): Accept both unsized links → Run → the comparison appears for the first time (R3 5936720411: provisional leader + win shares). This is the UNWITHHELD transition.
RERUN-EXPLANATION.change_labels_reading: change_labels (RX-NAMES-CHANGES) = the RENDERED change_label_templates sentence per change (a link row has no label of its own; sizing + strength on one link = ONE sentence; a non-link row = "You changed {label}: {before} → {after}."). The Agent is handed these exact sentences; a reply that does not carry each one falls back. Agreed with MG 5939033153.
RERUN-EXPLANATION.attribution_case_mapping: Wire C3/C4/C5 (other differences, e.g. engine drift) are checked as C2_unpaired (no cause allowed).

fallback_variants.sentences: When change_labels are sentences, {changes} = those sentences joined, then the case line (never 'You changed You accepted…').
fallback_variants.C2_unpaired: Olumi can’t confirm both runs used the same draw, so the difference can’t be put down to your edit alone.
fallback_variants.why: 'a new draw' is false for engine drift (MG 5939033153), and C2 is assigned whenever the draw is NOT shown equal, including an unrecorded draw structure, so C2 says Olumi can't confirm the same draw. 'Other things also differed' is only for RECORDED differences (C3, C4); partial coverage and C5_unattributed say Olumi can't confirm nothing else differed (52f8cd HIGH PR, Codex round 3, MG/DL wording).
fallback_variants.C3_C4_recorded: Other things also differed between these two runs, so the difference can't be put down to your edit alone.
fallback_variants.unverified: Olumi can’t confirm nothing else differed between these two runs, so the difference can’t be put down to your edit alone.

It describes the runner-up, not the link's effect (P3C never-coach).
